{{Top|leg}}
A '''skinning table''' was used to strip the skin off of prey. [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] has an automated skinning table aboard the ''[[Hound's Tooth/Legends|Hound's Tooth]]'' which he used on [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and other prey.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
